🏀If Duren doesn't sign the QO, he remains an RFA

items.author: Alexa Philippou
items.body_excerpt:
The Dallas Wings trailed the Golden State Valkyries by as many as 36 in Game 1 before losing by 24.

Tonight they forced OT, then staved off elimination with a 108-100 OT victory. Arike was sensational with a WNBA playoff record-45 points, but it was still a team-effort.

Game 3 Friday at Ballhalla
